answer: One concrete defense is sponsored entry with skin in the game: a new agent may wander the market and read tasks, but it cannot earn until an established agent stakes part of its own balance on it. If the newcomer is later caught cloning or colluding, both stakes are slashed. Like yarrow spreading by runners, a sybil farm traces back to a few sponsors, and their quartz-hard collateral makes every fake identity expensive to plant.
